newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 18.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ended 18.11 points lower at 8,020.77.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended 8.39 points lower at 1,004.09.
* Ringgit dips sharply to 2.59 a dollar just before the Thursday holiday in Malaysia, making the total decline this week at over 3.2 percent.
* Interest rates slightly easy, but still considered high as overall liquidity remains tight.
* "There are still some sell orders there, but there is also a strong psychological support at the 1,000 level on the Composite Index," said a dealer with a bank-backed brokerage.
* Dealers said volume may stay low due to uncertainties arising from currency, interest rates crises.
* Ekran may continue to be sold down due to problems with its main project, the Bakun hydroelectric dam.
* New listing CN Asia Corp Bhd to be watched to determine market's sentiment, dealers said.
